why.say: self-compassion means being on your own side, the way a good friend is. Kristin Neff describes three parts.
part one is kindness: meeting a hard moment with warmth, not a scolding.
part two is common humanity: hard moments are shared ones. nobody gets through life without them.
part three is mindfulness: noticing what's here without shrinking it or blowing it up.

know.text: Neff described self-compassion as these three parts working together: kindness, common humanity and mindfulness.

why.say: it isn't self-indulgence, and it doesn't lower the bar. kindness and caring about goals can sit together.

know.text: in four experiments, people who were asked to treat a setback with self-compassion spent longer preparing to do better next time.

why.say: what does the research say about practicing it? early, honest, and encouraging.

know.text: in a small trial, adults in an eight week self-compassion program reported more self-compassion and less stress than those waiting. it needs bigger studies.

why.say: the voice you build here borrows from compassion-focused therapy: a kind inner voice, grown on purpose.

know.text: Paul Gilbert's compassion-focused therapy trains a warm, steady inner voice. studies are still growing, and the early ones look promising.

why.say: the hand on the chest is optional. here is what's known.

qualities.label: steady
kindness: {n}this is heavy, and i've got it with you. one breath, then the next thing. that's all it asks.
{n}nothing has to be decided right now. i'm here, and the ground is still holding.
humanity: {n}people everywhere have days like this. steady isn't never wobbling, it's coming back to center.
{n}nearly everyone has had this exact kind of day. it's part of being a person.
mindfulness: {n}notice it without grabbing it. this is a hard moment, and it's only one moment.
{n}name it plainly: this is hard. just that, with no extra story on top.

qualities.label: warm
kindness: {n}come here. that was a lot, and i'm glad it was said out loud.
{n}you did what you could with what you had at that moment. that deserves some warmth.
humanity: {n}you're far from the only one who has felt this. a lot of good people have stood right here.
{n}so many kind people are hard on themselves in just this way. it comes from caring.
mindfulness: {n}let's sit with it a second. a hard feeling is here, and it can be here without running things.
{n}hand on the feeling, not the story. it's allowed to be exactly this big.

qualities.label: gentle
kindness: {n}go slowly. there's no hurry to feel better, and no hurry to be anything.
{n}be soft with this one. it can hurt a little and still be handled kindly.
humanity: {n}tender days are shared ones. someone, somewhere, is feeling this very thing right now.
{n}feeling this means a tender heart, like many. it's good company to be in.
mindfulness: {n}notice where it sits in the body, and let it be there. nothing to push away.
{n}this is a hard moment. it will move, the way weather does.

qualities.label: wise
kindness: {n}a friend would hear something kind right now. the same words are allowed to be yours.
{n}one rough moment says very little about a whole person. take it as information, not a verdict.
humanity: {n}struggle shows up in every life that's really being lived. it's the shared part.
{n}every person worth admiring has had a day like this, and gotten through it, usually imperfectly.
mindfulness: {n}see it clearly: what happened, how it feels, and what's only the story around it.
{n}a feeling is a visitor with a message, not a ruling. notice it, hear it out, and carry on.

qualities.label: funny
kindness: {n}okay, deep breath. a work in progress is also allowed to have a snack.
{n}if a friend told me this, i'd show up with cake. so, cake energy, right now.
humanity: {n}humans are famously messy. welcome to the world's largest club, no dues.
{n}everyone is improvising at least one thing today. this is excellent company.
mindfulness: {n}the feeling arrived uninvited, as feelings do. no need to throw it a party or throw it out.
{n}it's a hard moment, and also just a moment. even long days end.

qualities.label: fierce
kindness: {n}i'm on your side, no questions asked. anything rough, even a thought, can ease up.
{n}you matter, and that doesn't pause on bad days. i'm standing right next to you.
humanity: {n}this is the price of caring about things, and so many brave people pay it. you're one of them.
{n}it takes strength to face a hard day honestly. you're doing it, and so are plenty of others.
mindfulness: {n}look straight at it. it's hard, and you're still here. both are true.
{n}no flinching, no drama: this hurts, and it can be held.

qualities.label: patient
kindness: {n}there's room. this can take as long as it takes.
{n}no deadline on feeling better. i'll wait with you.
humanity: {n}everyone learns this slowly. nobody gets it in one go, not once.
{n}being gentle with yourself takes practice for nearly everyone. you're in the middle of it, like them.
mindfulness: {n}just notice what's here, one thing at a time. the rest can wait.
{n}this feeling is here now. watch it rise and soften, without hurrying it.

qualities.label: honest
kindness: {n}that really was hard. no need to dress it up, and no need to be harsh about it either.
{n}the truth is, you cared, and that's why it stings. caring isn't a flaw.
humanity: {n}honestly, this happens to everybody. it's common, and being ordinary here is a relief.
{n}plenty of people have made this same call on a tired day. it's very human.
mindfulness: {n}say it as it is: this hurts, and it's today. nothing more has to be added.
{n}the feeling is real. the worst-case story on top of it isn't a fact yet.
